HediffDef.label: respiratory failure
HediffDef.description: Breathing has stopped. Restore a clear airway and functioning lungs. Unprotected cerebral hypoxia can kill in about 1.5 game hours, before the roughly three-hour respiratory failure timer.

HediffDef.label: acute liver failure
HediffDef.description: No functioning liver tissue remains. A functioning replacement can resolve this failure. Without it, failure progresses toward death over approximately one game day.

HediffDef.label: acute renal failure
HediffDef.description: No functioning kidney tissue remains. One functioning kidney or a suitable replacement can resolve this failure. Untreated complete failure becomes fatal over approximately five game days.

HediffDef.label: blood filtration failure
HediffDef.description: Blood filtration has stopped. Restore filtration capacity; untreated failure becomes fatal in about one game day.

HediffDef.label: metabolic failure
HediffDef.description: Metabolism has stopped. Restore the affected organs or capacity; untreated failure becomes fatal in about three game days.

HediffDef.label: coma
HediffDef.description: Consciousness is zero. Treat the cause to restore consciousness; persistent coma becomes fatal in about five game days. Coma alone does not imply oxygen deprivation.
